3841.o: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3842.o: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3843.o: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

3844.o: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

3845.o: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

3861.o: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

3881.o: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un’Goro Crater.

3882.o: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un’Goro Crater.

3883.o: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un’Goro Crater.  Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.$B$BBring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol’anyee Marshal in Un’Goro Crater.

3884.o: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un’Goro Crater.

3901.o: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

3902.o: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

3904.o: Bring 8 crates of Milly’s Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

3905.o: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

3906.o: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.$B

3907.o: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.$B

3908.o: Take Linken’s Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3909.o: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3912.o: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova’s instructions to find Gaeriyan.

3913.o: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

3914.o: Deliver Linken’s Superior Sword to Linken in Un’Goro Crater.

3921.o: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

3922.o: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

3923.o: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3924.o: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3941.o: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal’s Refuge.

3942.o: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

3961.o: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal’s Refuge.

3962.o: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal’s Refuge.$B$BFind Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

3981.o: Find Commander Gor’shak in Blackrock Depths.$B$BYou recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

4001.o: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard’s kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou recall Gor’shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.$B

4002.o: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

4003.o: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell. $B

4005.o: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.$B$BUse the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.$B$BAfter you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal’s Refuge.

4021.o: Bring a Piece of Krom’zar’s Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

4022.o: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.$B

4023.o: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.$B$BYou have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

4024.o: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael’Gar.$B$BYou only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael’Gar’s remains to capture the Fiery Essence.$B$BReturn the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.$B$B

4061.o: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.$B$BYou recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4062.o: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.$B$BYou recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.$B

4063.o: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

4081.o: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!$B$BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.$B$B

4082.o: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!$B$BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

4084.o: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.
